data.one_liner: A responsive layout system with scaling extensions, grids, container queries, and adaptive widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides an intelligent scaling engine for Flutter apps. It scales UI across Mobile, Web, and Desktop using simple extensions, smart container queries, screen breakpoints, and zero overhead.
use_when: You need to scale UI elements, spacing, and text uniformly across different screen sizes.
You require a complete responsive design system with breakpoints, grids, and adaptive widgets like navigation and tables.
avoid_when: You prefer a strictly standard Material layout without design-to-screen pixel scaling.
You are already heavily invested in another responsive layout package.
strengths: Zero external dependencies and O(1) inline math.
Comprehensive suite of responsive widgets including container queries, slivers, and adaptive navigation.
weaknesses: Global scaling can sometimes alter text scaling expectations if not configured carefully.
Requires adherence to specific design baseline dimensions.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app with ScalifyProvider and provide your design dimensions.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer auto-scaling via wrapping screens with UI scaling breakpoints rather than granular extension math.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a simpler builder-based layout selection for screen sizes.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic percentage-based sizing extensions without a full layout engine.
